dct_description_sm: Cultural and historic places: museums, galleries, theatres, places of worship, monuments, and historic sites tagged via `tourism`, `amenity`, `historic`, or `heritage`. Useful for heritage protection, cultural mapping, and tourism context. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [tourism](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism), [amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [historic](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:historic), [heritage](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:heritage) - Part of the [country exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
